name: Elastic Text
description: A bold, playful stretch-and-snap text animation template. Great for mood-driven social posts and any brand with a casual, punchy voice.

name: Feature List [Apple Event]
description: A feature list template with the measured pacing of an Apple event presentation. Good for product launches and keynote-style content where each feature deserves its own moment.

name: Glide
description: A smooth animation template from Antinomy with fluid elegant motion. Works for product showcases and abstract visual content where subtlety is the goal.

name: Glitch 01: Text Reveal
description: A text reveal template with digital glitch distortion effects. Good for tech brand intros and motion design with a more edgy aesthetic.

name: Glitch 02: Text Reveal
description: A second glitch text reveal template with different distortion characteristics. Works alongside the first glitch template for variety within the same aesthetic.

name: Glitchy Text Reveal
description: An animated text template inspired by sportswear branding. Great for community events and any brand driving RSVPs.

name: Gradients: Animated List
description: A list template where each item has its own animated gradient treatment. Ideal for feature lists and visual menus where color adds hierarchy.

name: Gradients: Logo Reveal
description: A logo reveal template where shifting gradient layers surface the mark. Good for brand intros where color is part of the identity.

name: Morph: Dots To Text
description: An animation template where dots gradually rearrange themselves to spell out text. A distinctive way to open a reel or introduce a brand name without a standard text reveal.

name: Morph: Inflating Text
description: A text animation template where letters swell and inflate with a soft morphing effect. Works for playful headlines and expressive brand animations.

name: Morph: Lines To Text
description: An animation template where lines rearrange and resolve into readable text. Works for abstract intros and data-driven motion graphics.

name: Morph: Shape To Text
description: A morphing animation template where an abstract shape gradually transforms into readable text. Good for concept-driven openers and creative intros.

name: Motion Blur
description: A blur-in text template inspired by fintech and app marketing. Great for app promos and any brand delivering a clean, confident message.

name: Motion Design: Looped Text
description: A text template that scrolls in a continuous loop without a visible seam. Good for marquee effects and compositions that need ongoing typographic motion.

name: Multiply
description: A blend mode template from Antinomy using multiply effects to create layered color interactions between elements. Works for editorial motion graphics and experimental visual work.

name: Save The Date
description: An animated save-the-date template with a clean elegant reveal. Great for event invitations and launch announcements where you want the first impression to feel considered.
